Title: Requires automated external defibrillators at electric utility worksites
Summary: Requires at least one automated external defibrillator to be available at electric utility worksites where two or more electrical utility workers are performing work on electrical transmission or distribution lines of six hundred one volts or more; requires electric utilities to maintain emergency response plans with regard to the use of automated external defibrillators.
ActClause: AN ACT to amend the public service law, in relation to requiring automated external defibrillators at electric utility worksites
